name: piping-toolset
description: Directory edition: method, review and checklist guidance for six ASME B31.1 / B31.3 piping skills by pipingtoolset.com (pipe stress check, stress import, load cases, pipe supports, nozzle loads, bolted flanges). It includes no calculation scripts: Claude works each check by hand from the cited method and marks it not engine-verified. The full plugin with the fixture-verified engine is on GitHub. No ASME/API/PIP tables embedded; an optional connector serves cited table values to paid accounts.
